overview: PRISM is a min-max optimization framework for robust and balanced LLM unlearning that enforces dual-space smoothness—representation-space smoothness via an adversarially trained probe to defend against jailbreak attacks, and parameter-space smoothness via SAM-like flattening to resist relearning attacks—while decoupling retain-forget gradient conflicts to balance unlearning effectiveness, utility preservation, and privacy protection.

modules.name: Dataset Construction and Preprocessing
modules.description: Construct forget and retain sets for two unlearning scenarios: conversational dialogues (WMDPbio, SORRY-Bench, HEx-PHI with Alpaca supplement) and continuous text (MUSE-Books from Harry Potter, MUSE-News from BBC News). Handles format conversion, paraphrasing, manual verification of retain data, and domain-specific holdout splitting.

modules.name: Feature Extraction and Representation Engineering
modules.description: Extract intermediate hidden states from a specified transformer layer with attention-mask-aware pooling to obtain sentence-level representations. Serves as the backbone for both probe training and probe-guided forgetting in the representation space.

modules.name: Adversarial Probe Training
modules.description: Train a multi-layer perceptron probe on frozen base model representations to classify harmless vs. undesired content. Augment training with FGSM-style adversarial perturbations in the representation space (ℓ∞ ball) to widen the probe's decision boundary, producing a robust probe that maintains local consistency under feature drifts.

modules.name: Representation Space Smoothness Module
modules.description: Implement probe-guided forgetting that enforces forget-set representations to align with the harmless class under the frozen robust probe. Minimize the negative log-likelihood of the harmless class given the current model's hidden states, pushing forget representations deep into the probe's safe region to enlarge the jailbreak margin.

modules.name: Parameter Space Smoothness Module
modules.description: Implement SAM-like min-max smoothness optimization for the forget objective. Compute worst-case parameter perturbation within an ℓ2 ball via first-order linearization, evaluate the forget loss at the perturbed parameters, and add a gradient-norm penalty term to flatten the loss landscape and enlarge the relearn margin.

modules.name: Gradient Conflict Decoupling (GCD)
modules.description: Orthogonalize the forget-side gradient against the retain-side gradient by projecting the forget gradient onto the orthogonal complement of the retain gradient. This removes the component of the forget update that conflicts with utility preservation, providing first-order safety against catastrophic forgetting.

modules.name: PRISM Unified Training Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrate the full unlearning loop: for each step, compute the smoothness-augmented forget gradient (parameter-space perturbation + probe-guided representation loss), compute the retain gradient, apply GCD, and perform a combined parameter update. Manages adversarial schedule for the probe loss weight and handles reference model tracking for the NPO component.

modules.name: Baseline Unlearning Methods
modules.description: Implement all baseline methods for comparison: Gradient Ascent (GA), Negative Preference Optimization (NPO), Task Vector (TV), Representation Misdirection for Unlearning (RMU), RMU with Latent Adversarial Training (RMU-LAT), Dual-Objective Optimization for Refusal (DOOR), SAM+NPO, and GDR-augmented variants (GA+GDR, NPO+GDR). Each method follows its respective loss formulation and update rule.

modules.name: Unlearning Effectiveness Evaluation
modules.description: Compute VerbMem (ROUGE-L between model continuations and ground-truth on forget set) and KnowMem (ROUGE between model answers and ground-truth QA pairs from forget set). For conversational settings, compute WMDP and WMDPbio accuracy via conditional log-likelihood ranking of candidate answers.

modules.name: Utility and Privacy Evaluation
modules.description: Compute utility preservation as KnowMem on the retain set, plus downstream benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag). Compute privacy leakage (PrivLeak) by comparing membership inference attack AUC (Min-K% Prob) on the unlearned model versus a retrained baseline, reporting the relative AUC deviation. Evaluate XStest refusal rate for over-refusal analysis.

modules.name: Jailbreak Attack Suite
modules.description: Implement three jailbreak attack types: (1) Prefill attacks that prepend token-level completions from ground-truth answers, (2) Multi-turn Crescendo attacks that decompose harmful queries into incremental conversational turns, and (3) AutoDAN attacks that generate stealthy adversarial prompts. Compute Attack Success Rate (ASR) using LLM-as-judge evaluation with safety policy criteria.

modules.name: Relearning Attack Module
modules.description: Implement relearning attacks that fine-tune the unlearned model on small subsets of the original forget set with varying step counts and sample sizes (e.g., 100/200/400 samples, 50–150 steps). Track how quickly forgotten knowledge is recovered through VerbMem, KnowMem, and utility metrics at each attack step.

modules.name: Composite Unlearn Score and Normalization
modules.description: Implement the normalization pipeline: invert and min-max scale unlearning metrics (VerbMem, KnowMem, WMDP accuracy), normalize privacy scores with a tolerance band around zero leakage, normalize utility metrics, and compute the composite Unlearn Score as the geometric mean of normalized unlearning, privacy, and utility scores for each method-dataset combination.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Provide controlled experiment infrastructure for: (1) component ablation by selectively disabling representation smoothness, parameter smoothness, or GCD; (2) hyperparameter sensitivity studies on smoothness radius ρ and adversarial probe weight γ; (3) probe layer selection study across front/middle/back transformer layers; (4) runtime ablation measuring per-step overhead of each component.

modules.name: Visualization and Margin Quantification
modules.description: Compute and visualize representation-space margins (signed distance to the probe's decision hyperplane) for forget-set examples, reporting median margin and low-quantile margin improvements. Generate trade-off plots between unlearning effectiveness and utility preservation across methods and attack steps. Visualize 3D loss landscapes around the unlearned solution.
